decided_by: Malcolm, 2026-08-24 — chose wave 3 seedream_02 after seeing all five generative candidates measured against the deterministic version. He was shown that it carries 165px of heading ground at 1440 against the deterministic 475px, and picked it anyway: the complete forearm matters more to him than the text room. That is the call this file records.
note:
Header banner for the Creams & Moisturizers collection — the GENERATED wide frame.

WHAT THIS REPLACES. The first published version widened the library frame with scripts/extend-banner-canvas.py, which carries backdrop across and retires any limb touching the edge by fading it into shadow within ~190px. Malcolm read that as her forearm being cut off. Lengthening the fade to 600-1300px was tried and rejected: it removes the hard edge but a 1-D edge profile dragged sideways has by construction no variation along its length, so it reads as a smear rather than an arm.

THREE GENERATIVE WAVES, and the brief stopped steering after the second.
  wave 1  'elbow roughly one third in from the new left edge' — an instruction to FILL the left. Seedream re-rendered the scene zoomed in; subject started at 16-24%, leaving 0px of heading ground.
  wave 2  'nothing of her past 40 percent' — subject at 37-40%, 225-268px.
  wave 3  'nothing of her past 50 percent' — subject at 34-38%, 165-230px. NO BETTER. Seedream has a compositional floor here and will not pull the subject back past roughly a third, whatever number the brief carries. Worth knowing before anyone spends a fourth wave on it.

WHY THE NUMBERS LOOK WORSE THAN THE PICTURE. At a 1440 viewport a 4.42:1 master is only shown from x = W - 1440/(440/H), which for 4096x928 is x=1058 — the left 26% is never seen at all. So a subject starting at 34% leaves only the sliver between 26% and 34% as usable ground.

HENCE THE DESKTOP SCRIM, which no other banner here uses. Measured on this frame at its roomiest height: 165px of ground at 1440 and 5px at 1280. There is no text position that finds room — top, middle and bottom all measure 0px at 1280. So the ground is darkened deliberately with a left-to-right gradient on .collection-banner::before, exactly the mechanism the theme already uses on phones, turned sideways. Without it the heading would be unreadable on any laptop.

Label checked at 100%: Skingenetix with the dotted double-helix mark / COPPER PEPTIDE / ADVANCED NIGHT REPAIR in blue / PREMIUM FORMULA.

object-position is right center and not negotiable: the subject runs to x=4095 of 4096.

NEW FILENAMES, not edits of the previously uploaded pair. Shopify Files suffixes on a name collision rather than replacing, so re-using a name keeps serving the OLD picture — that has bitten this project three times. The superseded pair is left in Files; nothing references it.
